name: Amakawa Shizuku
source:

[url=https://vndb.org/c50516]Amakawa Yuu's[/url] well-mannered little sister. She has been childhood friends with Jun and is always with him. 

She acts active and cheerful in front of the people she trusts, such as her family or [url=https://vndb.org/c50526]Pops[/url].

She knows Chiharu has a crush on Yuu and is rooting for her.

[From the Official Artbook]
